meta.name: newsroom feed snapshot for KA-073
meta.provenance: Synthetic-but-realistic mirror of the bedimsecurity.com newsroom state shape ({articles, archive}; rows carry id/added_at/source/title/url/category/summary, added_at ISO-8601 Z, url https). The live shape was observed read-only 2026-10-06 and pinned verbatim as the KA-073 module contract; every id/title/summary here is inert and example.com-hosted on purpose. No credentials, no payloads, no real-world URLs.

articles.title: Zero-day exploited on home routers before patch available
articles.summary: Attackers chained a zero-day with a remote code execution bug against consumer routers; the first scans were caught by lab honeypots.

articles.title: Prompt injection pivots between MCP agents inside one tenant
articles.summary: A researcher chained prompt injections across MCP handoffs in a two-agent lab demo; no customer data was involved.

articles.title: NetScaler bug CVE-2026-31337 patched after honeypot sightings
articles.summary: Vendors shipped fixes for CVE-2026-31337, a remote code execution case; the changelog also lists cve-2026-1001.

articles.title: Long dwell time disclosed in state registry breach
articles.summary: Operators disclosed a months-long unauthorized access; stolen passwords were reset across the tenant.

articles.title: Coalition publishes OT security guidance for water utilities
articles.summary: The joint guidance covers network separation and patch cadence for operational technology sites.

articles.title: Contractor breach leaks airline passenger data via third-party portal
articles.summary: A third-party data processor exposed records, and leaked files surfaced through the week.

articles.title: Path traversal to root on backup appliance, no login needed
articles.summary: An attacker chain from path traversal ended in root on the lab appliance; no authentication was required.

articles.title: Disclosure slate argues 0-day markets need daylight
articles.summary: Policy scholars debate how 0-day markets should disclose to vendors.

articles.title: Backup platform restores service after encryption outage
articles.summary: The storage platform restored service after the outage and reported no data loss.

articles.title: Sandbox escape in an open-source coding agent
articles.summary: A sandbox escape let the demo agent read its own config file.

archive.title: OT baseline scans scheduled for the water sector
archive.summary: Baseline scans rotate through lab replicas first before any site visit.
